程序包 org.bukkit.conversations

类 ConversationContext

java.lang.Object
org.bukkit.conversations.ConversationContext
@Deprecated(forRemoval=true) public class ConversationContext extends java.lang.Object
已过时, 待删除: 此 API 元素将从以后的版本中删除。
The conversation API has been deprecated for removal. This system does not support component based messages and has been slowly losing functionality over the years as Minecraft has changed that this API can not adapt to. It is recommended you instead manually listen to the AsyncChatEvent or alternatively using Dialog to get user input.
ConversationContext 通过让开发者访问对话主题和一个通用映射来存储在所有 Prompt 调用之间共享的值， 从而在提示图中的节点之间提供连续性。

原文： A ConversationContext provides continuity between nodes in the prompt graph by giving the developer access to the subject of the conversation and a generic map for storing values that are shared between all Prompt invocations.

      @Nullable public @Nullable java.lang.Object getSessionData(@NotNull @NotNull java.lang.Object key)
      已过时, 待删除: 此 API 元素将从以后的版本中删除。
      获取在所有 Prompt 调用之间共享的会话数据。使用此方法作为在对话发展过程中通过每个 Prompt 传递数据的方式。

      原文： Gets session data shared between all Prompt invocations. Use this as a way to pass data through each Prompt as the conversation develops.

      参数:
      key - 会话数据的键。

      原文：The session data key.

      返回:
      请求的会话数据。

      原文：The requested session data.
